release_notes.en-US:
Keyboard support, visible save failures, and restore fixes.

Keyboard
- Press ? in the popup to see every key. Settings → Shortcuts lists them too.
- Press / or just start typing to search. Enter or ↓ jumps to the results; Esc clears, then closes.
- New keys: Home/End/PgUp/PgDn, Shift+arrows to select a range, Ctrl+A, F2 to rename, Shift+F2 to add a tag, Shift+F10 for the session menu, Ctrl+Enter / Alt+Enter to open replacing or adding to the current window, → to step into the tab list.
- Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z undo and redo. Menus and dialogs work with arrows and Esc.
- The focused item now has a visible outline.

Reliability
- If saving ever fails (for example a full disk), a red ! appears on the toolbar icon and the popup says since when and why. Before, auto-save could stop silently.
- Saved blank and new tabs no longer come back as "can not be opened" pages.
- Links saved without https:// open the site instead of a broken page.
- Tabs that can't be opened now say why.
- Background-window tabs load when you click them, and Back no longer returns to the placeholder page.
- Optional: put the device name in backup file names, so backups from several computers in one folder can be told apart.

Look
- The tab list shows which tabs belong to which tab group, with the group's colour.
- While searching, the filter shows how many sessions match (for example All [3/20]).
- The window title in the detail pane highlights search matches.
- Wider, tidier Settings page.
- Settings → Information links to the new bug report and feature forms on GitHub.
